description: A row-level security policy (FEAT-9 / #748, epic #743 item 5): Postgres-style RLS over one table for one command class, carrying a USING read filter and/or a WITH CHECK write filter that the SQL WHERE engine evaluates against the acting identity (current_user()/current_roles()). The on-disk policy.json projection of the replicated `policy:<uuid>` CRDT value. Mirrored by zetta::governance::Policy in include/zetta/governance/policy.hpp and enforced by policy_value_from_json() + Node::load_policies()/reconcile_policies() — keep them in sync. The predicate expressions are opaque objects here; zetta::query::PolicyPredicate owns their grammar + evaluation.

check.description: The write filter (WITH CHECK predicate): a written row is admitted iff it satisfies it. Opaque to governance. Absent when the policy has no write filter; an INSERT/UPDATE policy with neither check nor using admits no written row (#765).

command.description: The command class the policy governs. SELECT filters reads (USING); INSERT/UPDATE filter writes (WITH CHECK); ALL covers both.

created.description: ISO-8601 UTC creation stamp (millisecond precision, trailing 'Z').

database.description: The database owning the protected table.

id.description: The policy's UUID — its CRDT key and on-disk folder name. Present in policy.json and omitted from the CRDT value (the key carries it).

name.description: The policy's name (unique among policies on the node) — the DROP POLICY handle.

roles.description: The role names the policy applies to. Absent/empty means it applies to every role.

using.description: The read filter (USING predicate): a row is visible iff it satisfies it. Opaque to governance — zetta::query::PolicyPredicate owns its grammar + evaluation. Absent when the policy has no read filter; a SELECT/ALL policy without one admits no row (#765), never every row.

title: Policy
